lines.quote: Trump's foreign policy is on the ballot this year
lines.subject: Trump's foreign policy
lit: Trump's foreign policy is on the ballot
lines.whyGrammar: Frames the president's foreign policy record, including the Iran war, as a matter to be judged, which points to who is to blame rather than the reading itself.
lines.post_text: ‘We are seeing some real dysfunction': Trump's foreign policy under scrutiny ahead of midterms — Trump’s foreign policy is on the ballot this year: from siding with Putin, to annexing Greenland, to threatening Canada and starting a war with Iran. Retired Lt General and MS NOW military analyst Mark Hertling joins “The Weekend” to dig into Trump’s foreign policy record and whether it’s lived up to his America first promises.

relational.why: A midterm framing of Trump's foreign policy as a ballot question, which concerns the political contest rather than the war's costs or consequences.
